supporting_observations.claim: The account c.rwong was created at 13:46:43 UTC by ruth.moss, rather than at the approximate 13:42 time stated in the alert.
The account-creation event uses logon ID 0x471f200, matching a 13:42:41 Kerberos network logon for ruth.moss from WS-RMOSS-01.
The account name follows the stated temporary-account convention, and the recorded group addition is Seasonal, consistent with the described help-desk account-creation practice.
Ruth.moss initiated an RDP connection from WS-RMOSS-01 to DC-BLU-01, and the domain controller recorded a RemoteInteractive (Logon Type 10) logon.

Ruth.moss also launched GPMC on WS-RMOSS-01 with high integrity and the process connected to DC-BLU-01 over RPC, LDAP, and SMB. This is unusual given the stated practice that remote administration is done only from WS-KITO-01, but the records do not establish that this GPMC activity created the account.

known_telemetry_limitations: The available records do not show the exact client process or management action that issued the account-creation request.
The records show the Seasonal group addition but do not establish the account's complete group memberships or effective permissions.
The available activity does not establish whether the account creation was requested or approved.
claims_not_established: Whether ruth.moss created c.rwong as part of an authorized request or whether the account was created for an unauthorized purpose.
Whether ruth.moss's credentials or the relevant logon session were compromised or used by someone else.
Whether c.rwong received any additional permissions or was used after creation.
Whether the RDP and GPMC activity was an approved exception to the stated remote-administration practice.
additional_evidence_needed: Verify the help-desk request, approval, and intended purpose for c.rwong.
Review the account's complete group memberships, effective privileges, and subsequent sign-ins or activity.
Collect domain-controller directory-service auditing or other client attribution that identifies how the account and group change were submitted.
Confirm with ruth.moss and IT whether the RDP/GPMC activity from WS-RMOSS-01 was authorized.
